summary: Frontend regression for the 2 reported bugs (login freeze + drag-drop photo save). BOTH FIXES VERIFIED PASSING. Login with Admin@mastec.com completes and lands on JobsList without any freeze; page remains fully interactive (job cards clickable, Add dropdown opens, navigation works, back button works). MultiPhotoUpload works in all three modes: (1) file-picker single upload (pole-photo maxPhotos=1) — POST /api/upload-photo 200, onChange fires with correct URL; (2) file-picker multi-select upload (MGNV) — 2 files uploaded and both rendered; (3) real drag-and-drop via DataTransfer events on the dashed-border dropzone — 3rd photo added, state persisted, gallery shows 'MGNV PHOTOS (3)' with 3 thumbnails. useRef fix for stale closures confirmed by log: 'Calling onChange with: [url1, url2, url3]' — new photos correctly appended to existing state instead of overwriting.

issues: Dialog components render without Description/aria-describedby prop — a11y warning in console (from PHOTO MARKUP dialog and lightbox). Non-blocking but visible in devtools.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined}) to the MultiPhotoUpload lightbox DialogContent and to the PHOTO MARKUP dialog to silence Radix a11y warnings.

Optional refactor: MultiPhotoUpload.jsx removePhoto (line 143-146) still uses the closure `photos` and `onChange` directly instead of the refs. If parent updates value while user clicks X, it could delete a stale index. Consider using valueRef.current + onChangeRef.current there too for full consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: syncService.js idempotency guard (listenersInitialized flag) + cleanupSyncListeners in OfflineContext useEffect return correctly prevents duplicate window/serviceWorker listener registration on hot reload / re-mount.
syncPendingChanges now has axios timeouts (30s push, 60s pull) so a stuck sync no longer blocks the UI thread indefinitely — this was the root cause of the login-freeze report.

MultiPhotoUpload uses valueRef/onChangeRef/maxPhotosRef inside useCallback with [] deps — correct pattern to break stale-closure bug. processFiles reads valueRef.current at execution time, ensuring newly uploaded photos are appended to the LATEST value even if multiple uploads happen in quick succession.
MultiPhotoUpload removePhoto still uses the outer `photos` + `onChange` closure (line 143-146) — inconsistent with the ref-based approach used in processFiles. Low risk but worth aligning.
PoleForm.jsx is 1295 lines — exceeds the >700-line guideline. Consider splitting into Basic/Birthmark-MGNV/Spans/Markup sub-components.

handleFileChange (line 101-105) awaits processFiles but the input.value = "" reset happens synchronously after — this is fine but consider putting it in finally to ensure reset even if processFiles throws.

rca of the issue: Both reported issues were fixed correctly by main agent. (1) Login freeze RCA: prior versions registered window online/offline listeners and serviceWorker message listeners on every OfflineProvider mount without cleanup, and lacked axios timeouts on /api/sync/push, so a stuck sync request blocked the message-queue callbacks. Fix: listenersInitialized flag + cleanupSyncListeners on unmount + 30s/60s timeouts on push/pull. Verified: page never freezes, sync failures now surface as toast/status not hang. (2) Drag-drop save RCA: processFiles was created via useCallback with [value, onChange] deps but React sometimes carried the stale closure across rapid re-renders, causing the second upload to overwrite instead of append. Fix: replace closure vars with valueRef/onChangeRef/maxPhotosRef updated in useEffect. Verified: 3 sequential uploads produced a cumulative [url1, url2, url3] onChange payload.
